info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Careers Applications Interviews-v3-spec
info.description: The Interview Applications Retrieval API allows businesses to efficiently access and review interview applications submitted by candidates. This endpoint provides detailed information regarding candidate interviews, facilitating better decision-making in the hiring process. Typical consumers include HR teams and hiring managers who require up-to-date visibility into candidate statuses and interview schedules. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline their hiring workflows and enhance communication with candidates.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all applications related to interviews, providing essential details about each application for review and management.
